ideas.title: The Scope of Minnesota's Welfare Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of money involved and the number of people affected.
questions: How widespread is welfare fraud in Minnesota?
What is the total amount of money involved?
ideas.insight: The recent investigations and raids in Minnesota have highlighted a significant problem with fraud in children's programs and welfare services. A deeper investigation into the scope of the problem could uncover more widespread issues.
